commit.message:
Make code heap sizes robust across page/allocation granularity (review: TobiHartmann)

Leave a 256 KB margin (a multiple of the 64 KB max allocation granularity)
between NonNMethodCodeHeapSize and ReservedCodeCacheSize so the profiled/
non-profiled (and hot) nmethod heaps always meet their platform minimum,
avoiding a startup 'Invalid code heap sizes' abort that would let the test
pass without exercising the exit path. Also assert the VM did not fail code
heap creation so the test can never silently no-op.
